rationale: Open faulted branch l23 to isolate the fault. Closing normally-open tie switch tie_24 re-energizes b4 from b2 and, through l34, b3, yielding a radial tree rooted at source s: s-b1-b2 with b2-b4(tie)-b3. This restores all load buses (b2 priority 3, b3 priority 5, b4 priority 2) for priority_restored=10 (>= min 10), restored_load_kw=170, with 2 switching actions.
